commit.message:
task(web): record the minimap publish

112 objects to the teeline bucket, verified by reading all of them back; served
as image/svg+xml, and the built pages load the real images from the CDN. Also
corrects the plan's immutable-cache line: cf r2 objects put has no flag for it.
